plain_description.what: Using answer keys only (no judge), for each of 52 (benchmark, domain) groups in the 6-benchmark union with 18 models, checks by split-half whether the model ranking inside the group is reproducible, and gives each group a pass/fail class.
plain_description.why: Per-cell profiles are only useful if the per-cell ranking is stable; before this, union groups had no reliability measurement at all.
plain_description.information: It shows which groups can carry a per-cell profile and which cannot. Result: done; all 52 classed (on the strictest reading 27 pass, 12 pass with interval, 13 fail); overall reliability high (0.85 for group-specific differences). Two GPQA groups pass without any real within-group order. Key-based only, no judge; caveat: the union tree used leaks some evaluation questions into training (disclosed later).
